capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: 2027 Rivian R1 pack and charger assumed unchanged from 2026 (autoevolution 2027 article: Premium = former Large pack, Premium Long Range/Performance/Quad = 140 kWh Max pack; that article gives 105.5 and 140 kWh without saying gross or usable, so the pack may have been revised; no 2027 charging figures published). Green Car Reports and autoevolution: Max Pack 141.5 kWh usable (2027 press: 140 kWh).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: 2027 Rivian R1 pack and charger assumed unchanged from 2026 (autoevolution 2027 article: Premium = former Large pack, Premium Long Range/Performance/Quad = 140 kWh Max pack; that article gives 105.5 and 140 kWh without saying gross or usable, so the pack may have been revised; no 2027 charging figures published). Green Car Reports: Max keeps NCA 2170 cells (autoevolution says NMC).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Gen 1 EPA voltage window 216-459 V (400 V class); no page states a move to 800 V for the Gen 2 R1, and the Gen 2 DC peak (200-220 kW) is in the Gen 1 range.

preconditioning.notes: Navigation-triggered battery preconditioning plus manual battery preconditioning (no longer forced to use navigation) added by software 2025.18 for Gen 1 and Gen 2 (current state for owners). Before 2025.18 it was navigation-only.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 2027 Rivian R1 pack and charger assumed unchanged from 2026 (autoevolution 2027 article: Premium = former Large pack, Premium Long Range/Performance/Quad = 140 kWh Max pack; that article gives 105.5 and 140 kWh without saying gross or usable, so the pack may have been revised; no 2027 charging figures published). Green Car Reports: peak for Large and Max remains 220 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 2025 Gen 2 R1 is 11.5 kW (Green Car Reports: 48 amps, 11.5 kw); 2027 assumed unchanged.
